BuilderStocksWidget.js.t: If no prices can be loaded at all, it now says so (with why) instead of sitting on "Loading prices". Lifting the last finger after pinching the heatmap no longer counts as a tap.

Steadier Listen recordings: shorter pieces joined smoothly and steadier voice settings, to stop the voice drifting into a whisper. Page headers and page numbers are no longer read aloud. Calls you already recorded still play free.
Past calls you've already recorded with ElevenLabs show a green "Recorded" tag (or "Partly recorded"), so you can see where credits went. Those play free.
New under the Voice button: Saver quality, which records with ElevenLabs' Flash model in the same voice for about half the credits. Standard stays the default.
No more false Update ready right after installing: it double-checks GitHub before showing the notice.

Listen now reads the full prepared remarks (about 30 minutes for Lennar), instead of stopping when an executive mentions the Q&A early. It checks your ElevenLabs credits first, and saves what it made if they run out. Next-call dates no longer show last quarter's date.

BorrowerCreditWidget.js.t: The FHA chart is now "Mortgage serious delinquency by loan type": FHA vs Fannie Mae vs Freddie Mac, without the 30- and 60-day lines. In Share as PDF it sits on page 1 next to Going seriously delinquent, and Where late mortgages go now shares a slide with Rejections.

Fixed the Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac lines on the FHA delinquency chart: each report now fills in 13 months, so both lines rebuild back to 2015 over about two opens. If either site blocks the download, you'll see it in orange instead of a missing line.

FHA delinquency now compares against conventional loans: Fannie Mae's and Freddie Mac's serious delinquency, back to 2016 (fills in over a few opens). PDF: one Who slide with FICO, first-time vs repeat and DPA; the reasons slide says which reasons you hid.
Hiding a reason under FHA "Share by reason" now re-scales the reasons left to 100%, and the new-delinquencies count above shows only their loans. The sentence and the PDF follow.
Tap a reason under FHA "Share by reason" to hide or show it (the PDF follows). The "Who's getting mortgages" and credit score charts, and their PDF slide, are gone.

Three new FHA sections from HUD's monthly report: who's falling behind (serious delinquency by credit score, down payment help, first-time buyers, vintage and more, vs a year ago), why borrowers fall behind, and failure rates by loan vintage. Each gets its own slide in Share as PDF. The first open after updating reads HUD's newest report again, so give it an extra minute.

ReportsWidget.js.t: MBA Forecast Commentary picks up every edition on MBA's archive page, including ones MBA posted as a web page (like October 2026), which open in Safari.
Builder earnings-release cards removed: builder content is now just the investor decks. MBA Forecast Commentary is found from MBA's archive page, wherever MBA stores it.

ElevenLabs key is now just for Builder Stocks' earnings calls.

InflationWidget.js.t: Tapping the widget right after closing it now opens Inflation every time, instead of sometimes landing on Scriptable's script list. Closing the view stops the slow downloads; whatever didn't finish catches up on the next open.

A Fed calendar at the top (next FOMC meetings, minutes, Board speeches, in Central time). Open "What people expect" to see each group, with chips to hide them, plus forecasts running past Today: economists, Fannie Mae, the market model and the Fed's projections.

New: is inflation heading up or down? A scorecard of eight signals (today's pace, what people expect, wages, oil, producer prices, new-lease rents, long-run expectations, supply chains), with a chart for each and a two-slide PDF.
